Identify whether issues originate from market data, liquidity, pricing logic, configuration, execution, integration, or downstream processing . Document and manage defects through resolution. Partner with Front Office, Product Management, Technology, and Operations to support release readiness. Required Qualifications Strong knowledge of FX markets and electronic trading . Hands-on understanding of front-office pricing and price construction . Knowledge of liquidity-provider pricing, aggregation, bid/offer spreads, markups, pricing tiers, and executable pricing. Understanding of electronic trade/order execution. Experience with UAT, functional, integration, and regression testing in Capital Markets. Ability to independently develop test scenarios and determine expected results. Strong defect investigation and root-cause analysis skills. Knowledge of the front-to-back trade lifecycle. Preferred Qualifications Direct OneZero experience. Experience with other eFX aggregation, pricing, or execution platforms. Experience working directly with FX Trading, eTrading, or Front Office teams. FIX/electronic trading messaging knowledge. Jira and/or PractiTest experience. Experience supporting trading-platform implementations or major releases. We offer: A highly competitive compensation and benefits package. A multinational organization with 58 offices in 21 countries and the possibility to work abroad. 10 days of paid annual leave (plus sick leave and national holidays). Maternity & paternity leave plans. A comprehensive insurance plan including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long-/short-term disability (plans vary by region). Retirement savings plans. A higher education certification policy. Commuter benefits (varies by region). Extensive training opportunities, focused on skills, substantive knowledge, and personal development. On-demand Udemy for Business for all Synechron employees with free access to more than 5000 curated courses. Coaching opportunities with experienced colleagues from our Financial Innovation Labs (FinLabs) and Center of Excellences (CoE) groups. Cutting edge projects at the world’s leading tier-one banks, financial institutions and insurance firms. A flat and approachable organization. A truly diverse, fun-loving, and global work culture. review_candidates.title: Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where control has to hold up at the edge of the envelope. Getting that right across a family of airframes is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software. As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it, setting the control standard as the team grows. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from tuned control laws to reinforcement-learning policies trained in simulation and flown on hardware, and decide what actually flies. Responsibilities System Identification: Design excitation maneuvers and fit airframe models from flight data, with quantified error bounds. Control Law Design & Tuning: Inner rate and attitude loops through outer position loops, with allocation, gain scheduling, and manual or automated tuning across the airframe family and flight envelope. Sim-to-Real: Keep the in-house simulator faithful to the identified model, so control developed in simulation transfers to the aircraft. Model Consumption: Turn the stability derivatives and coefficient tables from Aerodynamics into flying control. Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior control and GNC engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, controls, robotics, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification & Control: Proven, hands-on identification and control on multirotor or fixed-wing platforms, validated in flight, with depth in at least one of MPC, INDI, or geometric control. Embedded Realization: Real-time control implementation on constrained targets, split cleanly between a microcontroller and a companion computer. Learning-Based Control: Familiarity with reinforcement learning and simulation-based training, and the judgment to know when a learned policy beats a classical design. Professional Attributes: Empirical and hardware-honest, disciplined about experiments and validation, grounded in real flight data. Communicates clearly, able to present control and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Bonus: Multi-airframe or hover-to-cruise transition experience. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

review_candidates.title: Financial Analyst
review_candidates.description: About 'Grey Brick Capital' 'Grey Brick Capital' is a Luxembourg-based holding and investment company specialising in systematic research and autonomous algorithmic trading. We build and run trading strategies grounded in rigorous quantitative research, and we are expanding the research team behind them. The role We are looking for an English and Russian-speaking Financial Analyst with deep expertise in US equities to join our research team. Vast experience is not required but a desire to learn and explore is expected. You will source, clean and analyse large datasets, develop and test hypotheses about US equity markets, and translate your findings into inputs for our trading models. You will work closely with our quantitative researchers and developers, so you should be comfortable turning an analytical idea into something measurable, testable and reproducible. What you will do Conduct fundamental and quantitative research on US-listed equities, sectors and market structure. Build, maintain and audit large financial datasets (pricing, fundamentals, corporate actions, alternative data); ensure data quality and point-in-time integrity. Design and run statistical analyses and backtests; evaluate signals for robustness, decay and overfitting. Build and maintain analytical models and dashboards in Excel and Bloomberg; automate recurring workflows where possible. Monitor earnings, macro releases and corporate events relevant to the US equity universe and assess their impact on live and candidate strategies. Document research clearly and present findings and recommendations to the research and trading teams. Contribute to risk and performance reviews of existing strategies. What we require Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering or a related quantitative field. Experience working with big data: large time-series or cross-sectional datasets, data cleaning, joining multiple sources, handling survivorship and look-ahead bias. Advanced Microsoft Excel (complex modelling, Power Query, VBA) and strong proficiency with Bloomberg Terminal (Excel API, BQL/BDH, screening, event and fundamentals data). Deep understanding of mathematics, statistical analysis and probability theory: regression, hypothesis testing, time-series methods, distributions, Monte Carlo methods, understanding of Markov and Hidden Markov models. Strong grasp of US market mechanics: trading sessions, corporate actions, index rebalances, earnings cycles, regulatory filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K). Clear written and spoken English and Russian. Precise, well-structured communication of complex results. Attention to detail, intellectual honesty and the discipline to distinguish signal from noise. Eligibility to work in the EU, or willingness to relocate with visa sponsorship. Nice to have Python or R for data analysis (pandas, NumPy, statsmodels) and SQL. Experience with backtesting frameworks or working alongside systematic trading teams. Familiarity with alternative data (sentiment, web, transactional) and with data vendors such as Refinitiv, FactSet, Compustat or CRSP. Knowledge of portfolio construction, factor models and risk management. What we offer Competitive salary €60,000-€96,000 plus discretionary performance bonus. Pension contribution, health insurance, relocation support. A small, highly technical team with short decision paths and direct exposure to live trading. Large research budget for data, tools and training. Modern office.

review_candidates.title: Director/a de centro (ej: Director/a Kids&Us Parque Venecia)
review_candidates.description: ¿Te imaginas liderando un proyecto educativo con impacto? Si tienes experiencia dirigiendo equipos en el ámbito educativo o retail y te apasiona el aprendizaje, el desarrollo de personas y el contacto con familias, este reto puede ser para ti. El rol de School Director en Kids&Us (Córdoba/Granada/Málaga/Almeria) te permitirá combinar visión estratégica, vocación educativa y habilidades comerciales para impulsar el crecimiento del centro, inspirar a tu equipo y conectar con la comunidad. En Kids&Us creemos que aprender inglés debe sentirse tan natural como aprender la lengua materna. Por eso hemos creado nuestro propio universo, con personajes y historias únicas en los que los niños y niñas se ven reflejados. A través del juego, la música y experiencias sensoriales, hacemos que el inglés cobre vida. Nuestro propósito es claro: We ignite children’s future to unleash collective hope. Por qué te encantará liderar un centro Kids&Us Formarás parte de una comunidad internacional con propósito, que impacta en la vida de miles de niños y familias. Descubrirás un método probado e innovador, inspirado en la adquisición natural del lenguaje. Disfrutarás de la satisfacción de ver progresar a tus alumnos/as y del reconocimiento de las familias. Vivirás el reto y la emoción de gestionar un proyecto dinámico e innovador. Crecerás en un entorno colaborativo, con aprendizaje continuo y oportunidades reales de desarrollo. Sentirás el orgullo de pertenecer a una marca reconocida, que comparte valores y pasión por la educación. Tu rol Supervisar las operaciones diarias del centro, garantizando la excelencia académica y comercial. Liderar e inspirar un equipo creando un entorno motivador e inclusivo. Impulsar la matriculación y fidelización mediante estrategias efectivas de ventas y marketing. Fomentar relaciones sólidas con las familias y la comunidad local, promoviendo nuestra misión y valores. Lo que necesitas Experiencia previa en educación, retail o gestión de equipos (dirección de escuela, responsable de tienda, adjunto a dirección...). Excelentes habilidades organizativas, comunicativas y de liderazgo. Mentalidad proactiva y orientada a objetivos, a cliente y a la construcción de relaciones comerciales. Nivel de inglés B2 o superior. Certificado de Delitos Sexuales sin antecedentes, obligatorio por ley para trabajar con menores en España Ready to inspire? We’d love to meet you! Cláusula informativa: Responsable del tratamiento: Kids&Us English, S.L. con domicilio en avenida Tudela, 12, 08242 Manresa (Barcelona).
